statusVocabulary.OBSERVED: Value is present and read directly from the pinned saved HTML or current Asterion code fact listed.
statusVocabulary.N/A: Source element is absent from the page; this is distinct from numeric zero.
statusVocabulary.UNKNOWN: Source page does not provide enough data to classify the value; no inference applied.
statusVocabulary.DAMAGED_SOURCE_TEXT: Primary source contains a literal replacement character; raw text is preserved and not repaired.

notes: Commander pages are a shared class, not one commander per faction.
The source page ID is read from its saved-from URL comment and is also the image suffix commanderShip_<id>.png.
Asterion asset mapping records the imported asset path by matching the current catalog import to its commander ID; it does not claim pixel identity with the saved source icon.
Argo and Judge requirement tooltip names identify a blueprint set and commander but state no numeric value; valueKind/value remain UNKNOWN/null.
Reanimator description includes U+FFFD in the pinned HTML between “15” and “ораблей”; the fixture preserves the replacement character instead of guessing the missing character.
